pairs: Quæsierunt me qui ante non interrogabant;
Those who before were not asking for me have sought me.
Those who have not sought me have found me.
ad gentem quæ non invocabat nomen meum.
it is I!” to a nation which was not invoking my name.
Expandi manus meas tota die ad populum incredulum,
I have extended my hands all day long to an unbelieving people,
qui graditur in via non bona post cogitationes suas.
who advance along a way that is not good, following their own thoughts,
Populus qui ad iracundiam provocat me ante faciem meam semper;
to a people who provoke me to anger before my face continually,
and who sacrifice upon the bricks.
and they sleep in the shrines of idols.
They eat the flesh of swine,
et jus profanum in vasis eorum;
and a profane elixir is in their vessels.
Isti fumus erunt in furore meo,
Such as these will be the smoke in my fury,
a fire burning all day long.
Behold, it has been written in my sight;
I will not be silent. Instead,
I will render retribution into their sinews.
Iniquitates vestras, et iniquitates patrum vestrorum simul,
Your iniquities are joined with the iniquities of your fathers,
For they have sacrificed upon the mountains,
and they have offended me upon the hills. And so,
et remetiar opus eorum primum in sinu eorum.
I will measure back to them, from their first work, into their sinews.
Quomodo si inveniatur granum in botro, et dicatur:
In the same way as it is said about a grain found in a cluster,
so will I act for the sake of my servants,
so that I may not destroy the whole.
And I will lead forth an offspring from Jacob,
et de Juda possidentem montes meos;
and a possessor of my mountains from Judah.
And my elect shall inherit it,
and my servants shall live there.
Et erunt campestria in caulas gregum,
And the open plains will become sheepfolds for the flocks,
et vallis Achor in cubile armentorum,
and the valley of Achor will become a domicile for the herds,
for my people who have sought me.
And you who have forsaken the Lord,
qui obliti estis montem sanctum meum,
who have forgotten my holy mountain,
who set a table for Fortune,
and who offer libations concerning her:
I will number you with the sword,
and you will all fall by slaughter.
For I called and you did not respond;
And you did what is evil in my eyes;
et faciebatis malum in oculis meis,
and what I did not will,
Propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Because of this, thus says the Lord God:
ecce servi mei laudabunt præ exsultatione cordis,
Behold, my servants will give praise in exultation of heart,
et vos clamabitis præ dolore cordis,
and you will cry out in sorrow of heart,
and you will wail in contrition of spirit.
et dimittetis nomen vestrum in juramentum electis meis;
And you will leave behind your name to my elect as a curse.
And the Lord God will put you to death,
et servos suos vocabit nomine alio:
and he will call his servants by another name.
in quo qui benedictus est super terram benedicetur in Deo,
By that name, whoever is blessed on earth, will be blessed in God.
et qui jurat in terra jurabit in Deo,
And whoever swears on earth, will swear by God.
quia oblivioni traditæ sunt angustiæ priores,
For the past anguishes have been delivered into oblivion,
et quia absconditæ sunt ab oculis meis.
and they have been hidden from my eyes.
Ecce enim ego creo cælos novos, et terram novam;
For behold, I create the new heavens and the new earth.
et non erunt in memoria priora, et non ascendent super cor.
And the former things will not be in memory and will not enter into the heart.
Sed gaudebitis et exsultabitis usque in sempiternum in his quæ ego creo:
But you will be glad and exult, even forever, in these things that I create.
quia ecce ego creo Jerusalem exsultationem,
For behold, I create Jerusalem as an exultation,
and its people as a joy.
And I will exult in Jerusalem,
and I will rejoice in my people.
et non audietur in eo ultra vox fletus et vox clamoris.
And neither a voice of weeping, nor a voice of outcry, will be heard in her anymore.
Non erit ibi amplius infans dierum,
There will no longer be an infant of only a few days there,
et senex qui non impleat dies suos,
nor an elder who does not complete his days.
For a mere child dies at a hundred years of age,
et peccator centum annorum maledictus erit.
and a sinner of a hundred years will be accursed.
secundum enim dies ligni erunt dies populi mei,
For according to the days of a tree, so will be the days of my people.
And the works of their hands will be long-standing.
My elect will not labor in vain,
and they will not bring forth in disorder.
For they are the offspring of the blessed of the Lord,
and their posterity are with them.
And this shall be: before they call out,
The wolf and the lamb will pasture together.
The lion and the ox will eat hay.
And dust will be the food of the serpent.
neque occident in omni monte sancto meo,
and they will not kill, on all my holy mountain,
